title: "Demand"
author: "Manuel De la Cruz"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)

cardata <- read.csv("cardata.csv")

# =====================================================================
# 1. Descriptive Correlations
# =====================================================================

# 1.1 Scatterplot of price vs quantity
f1 <- ggplot(cardata, aes(x = price, y = quantity)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "darkred", se = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Figure 1: Price vs. Quantity of New Cars in Germany",
       x = "Retail price (EUR 1,000)",
       y = "Quantity sold")
print(f1)

# 1.3 Average lifetime CO2 damages of electric and non-electric vehicles
cardata <- cardata %>%
  mutate(co2cost = co2 * 190)

co2_present <- cardata %>%
  group_by(bev) %>%
  summarize(mean_co2_damage = mean(co2cost, na.rm = TRUE))
print(co2_present)

# 1.4 Histogram of lifetime CO2 damages of electric and non-electric vehicles
f2 <- ggplot(cardata, aes(x = co2cost, fill = factor(bev))) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6, bins = 34) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "coral", "1" = "seagreen"),
                    labels = c("Non-BEV", "BEV")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Figure 2: Lifetime CO2 Damages by Vehicle Type",
       x = "Lifetime CO2 damages (EUR)",
       y = "Distribution",
       fill = "Vehicle Type")
print(f2)


# =====================================================================
# 2. Logit Model Estimation
# =====================================================================

# Calculating market shares and the dependent variable
cardata <- cardata %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    s_j = quantity / marketsize,
    outside_share = pmax(1e-9, 1 - sum(s_j, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dep_var = log(s_j / outside_share)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2.1 OLS estimation
ols_model <- feols(dep_var ~ price + fuel_cost + volume + weight + kw + doors + 
                     bev + phev + diesel + hev | firm + class + body, 
                   data = cardata)
summary(ols_model)
ols_model

# 2.3 2SLS estimation with instruments for price
iv_model <- feols(dep_var ~ fuel_cost + volume + weight + kw + doors + 
                    bev + phev + diesel + hev | firm + class + body | 
                    price ~ iv_diff_fuelecon_loc_own + iv_diff_fuelecon_loc_comp + 
                            iv_diff_volume_loc_own + iv_diff_volume_loc_comp + 
                            iv_diff_kw_1_loc_own + iv_diff_kw_1_loc_comp,
                  data = cardata)
summary(iv_model)

# 2.4 Price elasticity and bev coefficient
alpha <- -coef(iv_model)["fit_price"]
bev <- coef(iv_model)["bev"]
mean_price <- mean(cardata$price)
mean_s_j   <- mean(cardata$s_j)

elasticity_at_mean <- -alpha * mean_price * (1 - mean_s_j)
```
